# approval-workflow

> Multi-level approval engine: amount-based routing, sequential levels with quorums, separation of duties, time-bound delegation, escalation on timeout and terminal states Python package `trysac-approval-workflow`, import name `approval_workflow`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
